annotations.title: Validate Indian tax and business identifiers

description: Check Indian identifiers by structure and check digit: GSTIN (state code, embedded PAN, check character), PAN, TAN, IFSC, Aadhaar (Verhoeff check digit), CIN and Udyam registration numbers. Pass one identifier or many, one per line; the type is detected unless given. Returns whether each is well-formed, a breakdown of what each part encodes, and which character is wrong. Format only: it cannot tell whether an identifier has been issued or is active. Aadhaar numbers are always masked in the output.

ids.description: One identifier, or several separated by newlines.

type.description: The identifier type. Leave as "auto" to detect it from the shape.
